item.title: ROBBERY IN NEW CANEY
item.description: A robbery has occurred at the Brokshire Brothers Fuel Center (old Overalls) at I-69 and FM 1485. Two black males in a white Jeep Cherokee with plates covered fled south toward Harris County on I-69. Precinct 4 Deputies are on the scene investigating.

item.title: FATAL CRASH ON I-45 IN CLEARING STAGES
item.description: Harris County Investigators remain on the scene of the fatal crash on i-45 southbound at Spring Stuebner, I45 southbound remains closed.

item.title: UPDATE-NEW CANEY FELONY THEFT-HELP IDENTIFY
item.description: About 9 pm Monday night, two black males driving a Jeep entered the Brookshire Fuel Center on FM 1485 at I-69.
